lines.text: Please. Just this once... miss your train.
[low, urgent, intimate] Nine minutes to keep him off the six-forty. And he had no idea.
lines.show: Nine minutes to keep him off the 6:40. And he had no idea.

lines.text: [flustered, too quick] I... take this train too. Sometimes.
[quiet, embarrassed] I'd never taken this train in my life.
[fast, breathless] Ten seconds. No plan. No way to explain.
[desperate, then soft] Kabir. Please. Just this once... miss your train.
[quiet, then a small smile] ...Okay. But you owe me a coffee.
[soft, wondering] He stayed. He didn't even ask why.
[low] Forty minutes later, every phone in the café lit up at once.
[shaken, quiet] The six-forty never made it to the next station.
lines.show: The 6:40 never made it to the next station.

lines.text: [quiet, staring at her] You knew. Didn't you?
[hesitant] I couldn't tell him. Not yet.
[uneasy] That night, at eleven eleven... it wasn't my phone that lit up.
lines.show: That night, at 11:11… it wasn't my phone that lit up.

lines.text: [barely a whisper, confused] Mira... why is your voice on my phone?
